proposal.reason: Main change is host one-sided RMA API enqueueing and plan orchestration (PutSignal/Signal/WaitSignal task creation, batching, and RMA launch flow). Additional review is needed for network because cross-node execution adds a dedicated GIN RMA proxy/plugin context and progress engine; for copy-engine because intra-node CE-based put/wait execution and synchronization are newly implemented; for communicator because numRmaCtx/hostRma capability negotiation, config validation, lifecycle teardown/init, and async error surfacing are changed; and for profiler because a new RMA API event type extends profiler descriptors and event-mask behavior.
